method: Every vendor page was loaded through the CubXL Pi (BYU campus network, AS6510). Product and Octopart pages: curl run on the Pi over Tailscale SSH, saved on the runner and parsed offline (fetch_via_pi.py). Amazon: a fresh headless Chrome on the runner with its traffic through an SSH SOCKS tunnel to the same Pi, images and fonts blocked, no sign-in; the tunnel was closed and the profile deleted afterwards. Nothing was written on the Pi. Raw HTML is not committed.
bot_checks_detail: Amazon search via curl: HTTP 503 automated-access page (then switched to the browser; 0 checks in 21 browser loads)
DigiKey via curl: Cloudflare 'Just a moment' challenge (403)
